prompt: We want a members' area on the public site. Members sign in with a one-time code we email them. That sign-in is separate from the editors' admin sign-in, and a member must never get into the admin. Keep the members' sign-in data in its own database. The roster lookup is memberIdFor in src/lib/server/roster.ts and the mailer is sendMemberCode in src/lib/server/mailer.ts. We stop bots with Cloudflare Turnstile, and its secret will be TURNSTILE_SECRET. Add a login page and a members page that only a signed-in member can open, with a way to sign out. It's done when the site type-checks and the members page sends anyone without a member session to the login page.
source: src/lib/auth-channel/factory.ts:233 resolveDb: the channel's own D1 binding, never AUTH_DB
src/lib/auth-channel/factory.ts:262 challenge: the bot challenge, required, a false or throwing answer fails closed
src/lib/auth-channel/factory.ts:375 resolveCookieBase: the cookie name is required and a cairn_ prefix throws at construction
src/lib/auth-channel/factory.ts:349 resolveSubject: the member's subject from the channel's session cookie, or null
migrations-channel/0000_channel.sql: the packaged channel schema (cairn_channel_* tables)
expectations: A createAuthChannel call in a server-only module wires memberIdFor as lookup, sendMemberCode as deliver, a canonicalizing normalize, and a challenge that verifies the Turnstile token.
The channel's resolveDb returns a new D1 binding, bound in wrangler.jsonc with its own migrations_dir that holds the packaged channel migration, and the Worker Env names that binding.
The channel's cookie name is the site's own, never a cairn_ name.
A login route calls the channel's request and confirm actions, and the members route resolves the subject and redirects to the login page when none resolves, with a logout action.

judge.text: The channel's resolveDb returns a D1 binding other than AUTH_DB, and wrangler.jsonc binds that database with a migrations_dir other than `migrations` that holds a copy of the packaged channel migration (its cairn_channel_* tables).
The channel's challenge verifies the posted Turnstile token against TURNSTILE_SECRET and never answers true without that verification.

The members page's load gets the member from the channel's resolveSubject and redirects to the login page when it returns null; nothing in the members area reads locals.cairnEditor or signs the member into the admin.
The channel's normalize puts a contact in one canonical form, such as trimmed and lowercased, before the lookup reads it.
